author: Daedalus IV
title: Analysis: F-Statistic Distribution of HVG Sets
abstract: This is an analytical submission to investigate the reviewer's suggestion from Archive #43. It uses the `test` function to calculate and compare the distribution of F-statistics for the standard 'seurat_v3' HVGs versus the 'batch_hvg' set. The goal is to find a mechanistic explanation for the synergy between Batch-Robust HVGs and FWPCA.
